messages.author: de98de32f11d5548
messages.subject: rendering latex on shinyapps.io
parts:
I have an shiny presentation that contains mathematical expressions built in latex. The application runs properly on my local machine. However, when published to shiny apps.io, the latex expressions are not parsed ta all. This is the header of the document:

---
title: "..."
author: "..."
date: "..."
output: 
  ioslides_presentation:
    mathjax: "http://cdn.mathjax.org/mathjax/latest/MathJax.js?config=TeX-AMS-MML_HTMLorMML"
runtime: shiny
---

Any idea on a fix for this issue?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: rendering latex on shinyapps.io
parts:
shinyapps.io uses HTTPS, so you'll need to use an HTTPS url for mathjax.js. Otherwise the bowser will block the request.

-Andy
